shapeSummary: Flat 25.4 x 30.5 mm, 1.6 mm thick PCB in the XZ plane with its bottom at Y=0. Two Ø2.2 mm through mounting holes sit at x=10.7, z=±12.7. Two Ø6.3 mm electrolytic capacitor cylinders rise 5.4 mm above the board, for a 7 mm total height. A 5x5x0.9 mm QFN IC block sits on top.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified. The analysis lists y=30.5 and z=7, which I mapped to the Y-up frame: board length on Z (30.5 mm) and total height on Y (7 mm).
PCB thickness (1.6 mm), capacitor height and diameter, and the IC size are assumed.
Capacitor and IC positions are approximate, estimated from the photo.
Signal pin holes, motor/power terminal holes, and small VBB/GND holes are omitted because their diameters and positions are not given.
SMD passives, the small secondary IC, and the markings are omitted.
Mounting-hole positions come from the estimate in the analysis, and both holes are on one side.
cadquery:
pcb = cq.Workplane('XZ').rect(25.4, 30.5).extrude(-1.6)
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(10.7, 12.7), (10.7, -12.7)]).circle(1.1).extrude(-1.6)
pcb = pcb.cut(holes)
caps = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 1.6, 0)).pushPoints([(-4, -10), (2, -7)]).circle(3.15).extrude(-5.4)
ic = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 1.6, 0)).center(3, 6).rect(5, 5).extrude(-0.9)
part = pcb.union(caps).union(ic)
